text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to wish you a happy<n>birthday, Satono. I
pray your future<n>endeavors be met with success.
Additionally...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared a congratulatory gift.<n>You'll find it
waiting in your room<n>later.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You really did that for me?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you so much! I'll... I'll<n>treasure it forever!
♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, so long as you like it, that's<n>enough for me.
After all, it's a—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh! This means it's the perfect<n>chance for me to try
breaking that<n>jinx!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There's one where you get<n>nightmares if you put a
gift from<n>someone you admire under your<n>pillow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
U-under your pillow?! Um, Satono, I'd<n>have to
advise you against—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Eheh. ♪ I won't spare an inch of<n>effort in trying to
break it, even if I<n>have to do it in my dreams! Okay,
here I go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Sh-she's completely off in her own<n>world... But I
really must get through<n>to her somehow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I need to tell her that my gift is a<n>specially-made
Mejiro family<n>birthday cake!
